subject: Magellan Bank — Residency & Deletion: chain-of-custody Q&A
messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@magellanbank.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Danielle Price <dprice@magellanbank.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Proof of deletion and chain-of-custody for Magellan tenant

Hi Marissa,

As part of our SOC 2 fieldwork the auditors have asked for proof that Magellan tenant data subject to our agreed TTLs has been deleted and that deletions include an auditable chain-of-custody (who initiated, job id, object ids/version ids where applicable). They specifically want: 

- Deletion run manifests (file-level) for tenant magellan-prod covering 2026-10-01 — 2026-10-15
- Logs showing delete job trigger, job id, and operator identity (service or user)
- Evidence of residency enforcement (where the data was stored and confirmation no replicated copies remain outside the allowed region)

Can you provide an export or point us to the artifacts (or let me know an ETA)? Auditor is KDPAudit (cc'ed) and they'd like the artifacts bundled by EOD Tuesday, 2026-10-20 if possible.

Appreciate it — Elena
Compliance Manager, Magellan Bank
[attachment: SOC2-request-Magellan-10-16.pdf]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Costa <elena.costa@magellanbank.com>, KDPAudit Team <audits@kdpaudit.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Request: Proof of deletion and chain-of-custody for Magellan tenant

Karthik / Jonas — forwarding Magellan's ask. Auditor wants manifests + chain-of-custody for recent tenant deletions. Key asks: file-level manifest for magellan-prod, job id, operator identity, and residency confirmation (no stale replicas).

What we can provide today:
- retention_policy_v2.pdf (attached) — policy and TTL config for magellan-prod (shows configured TTLs and S3 lifecycle rules)
- deletion_run_manifest_20261015.csv — run-id del-job-20261015-71 includes object keys and version ids (we generated during scheduled tenant cleanup)
- s3_lifecycle_manifest.txt — listing of lifecycle rules applied to magellan-prod buckets
- access_log_snippet_20261015.txt — service account invocation and orchestration logs (sanitized)

Questions:
1) Do we need full unredacted object keys/versions, or can we provide hashed identifiers plus version IDs?
2) Do auditors require stack-level evidence (e.g., S3 delete markers + replication state) or is our lifecycle manifest + deletion run manifest sufficient?

Jonas — can you confirm the run metadata (job id, who triggered it, and whether the cleanup removed versions or placed delete markers) so I can bundle artifacts?

I will prepare a Drive folder and a HubSpot ticket.

Thanks,
Marissa
SR. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: retention_policy_v2.pdf]

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Costa <elena.costa@magellanbank.com>, KDPAudit Team <audits@kdpaudit.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Proof of deletion and chain-of-custody for Magellan tenant

Marissa — quick update / technical summary (so we have a single artifact set to send):

Summary of run del-job-20261015-71 (tenant: magellan-prod)
- Trigger: scheduled TTL cleanup triggered via orchestration service "cleanup-svc" at 2026-10-15T02:17:42Z
- Job ID: del-job-20261015-71
- Initiator: system service account cleanup-svc@infra.redwood (IAM role: cleanup-runner)
- Objects processed: 18,742 keys across two buckets (magellan-prod-primary, magellan-prod-archive)
- Actions taken: permanent delete on non-versioned objects; delete markers placed for versioned objects and then asynchronously processed by S3 lifecycle to remove previous versions where replication not configured
- Residency: both buckets are provisioned in us-east-1 with versioning disabled on primary and enabled on archive (archive uses versioning to support point-in-time restores in-region only). No cross-region replication is configured for magellan-prod.

Artifacts attached to this email (zipped in Drive):
- deletion_run_manifest_20261015.csv — columns: object_key_hash, version_id (if applicable), action_taken, timestamp
- s3_lifecycle_manifest.txt — lifecycle rule ids and expiration/transition config
- access_log_snippet_20261015.txt — orchestration invocation and IAM principal (sanitized to remove tenant-sensitive tokens)

Notes on redaction: we can deliver hashed object_key values (sha256) plus version ids to satisfy auditor linkage without exposing raw keys. If KDPAudit insists on full keys, we'll need a signed NDA addendum from Magellan.

I can produce a signed run summary (GPG-signed) and a checksum of the deletion run manifest for auditor verification.

-Jonas
Staff Engineer, Storage Services
Redwood Inference
[attachment: deletion_run_manifest_20261015.csv]

From: KDPAudit Team <audits@kdpaudit.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Costa <elena.costa@magellanbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Magellan Bank — Residency & Deletion: chain-of-custody Q&A

Thanks for the artifacts — we reviewed the manifest and have two follow-ups before we close the control:

1) Chain-of-custody: please provide the run summary signed by the operator (if system account, provide orchestration entry showing the service account invocation and the signed job metadata). The checksum solution is acceptable — include the checksum algorithm and a GPG signature for the manifest.

2) Proof of non-replication: we need a console export or account-level policy showing replication settings are disabled for those buckets, or screenshots from your infra console. A short statement from your infra team confirming there are zero cross-region replicas for magellan-prod will suffice if accompanied by the lifecycle manifest.

If you can provide the signed manifest checksum + the replication statement by EOD Thursday 2026-10-22 we'll mark this control as provisionally closed pending minor admin review.

Regards,
KDPAudit Team

---
